# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

This corpus contains several hundred call snippets, but only a modest fraction are genuine sales/enquiry/negotiation calls. The majority fall into three non-sales buckets that were excluded from analysis: (1) **internal logistics/operations chatter** — especially the long "Yuvraj Operator" series about cutting-machine coil operations, print/sticker instructions, and vehicle loading; (2) **payment/documentation follow-ups** (UTR confirmations, debit/credit notes, bank transfer status) with no product negotiation; and (3) **personal/irrelevant calls** (the extensive "Vishal" series is cricket/family/gossip chat in Hindi-Gujarati, wrong numbers, voicemails).

The genuine sales core is roughly 60–70 calls spread across many different customer-facing reps (Varsha, Venkatesh, and others) handling inbound enquiries from fabricators, traders, engineers, and site engineers. Rates mentioned swing from ~₹53–54/kg (TMT, older call) to ₹69–84/kg (TMT/plates, later calls), showing this spans a period of significant steel price volatility. Given the frag束ary nature of many calls (price-only asks, single-line enquiries), this KB keeps conclusions tightly grounded in what's actually said — no invented SKUs, discount slabs, or warranty terms.

## Products & brand ladder

**Primary products actually quoted/negotiated in calls:**
- **TMT bars/rods** — grades **Fe500 / 500D / 550D / E250**; lengths typically 12m standard (customers sometimes need custom cuts/bends, e.g., 6m, 3m for bolt threading)
- **MS Plates / Checkered plates** — thickness range 2mm–45mm; standard sheet sizes like **2500×6300mm**, **8×4 ft**, **4×8 ft**; sold both ex-stock and "coil-cut to order"
- **ISMB (I-beams/joists), ISMC (channels), MS Angles (L-angle), Flats, Square/Rectangular tubes** — structural items in grades **E250** (standard) and **E350** (+₹3,000 premium per the Oct-2026 call)
- **CR (Cold Rolled) Coils/Sheets** — e.g., 0.6mm CR sheet matching **IS 513**; also "CRS" (likely Cold Rolled Steel/Sail product line) sold in fixed sizes (e.g., 20mm "sale CRS" only in specific tonnage)

**Brand ladder mentioned by reps/customers:**
- **"Sale" (SAIL)** — treated as a reference/benchmark brand; frequently sold at parity with **Vaisakh** ("Rate different இருக்காது sir, ரெண்டுமே same price தான்")
- **Vizag (RINL/VSP)** — BSC's own primary stocking source much of the time; price moves here are watched closely as a leading indicator for market-wide rate changes ("Vizag வந்த உடனே பாருங்க டக்குன்னு கம்மி பண்ணிட்டாங்க")
- **JSW, Tata Steel** — named by customers as comparison points ("Tata Steel-ல ₹60-க்கு வாங்கினேன்", "JSW ₹1000 increase பண்ணிருக்காங்க")
- Note: company explicitly does **not** deal in SHS/pipes/tubes in some calls ("SHS நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல sir"), while other reps do quote square/rectangular tube — suggesting product range varies by branch/rep or has changed over time.

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

- TMT 5.5m "flat" stock: **₹54 → negotiated down to ₹53.5** (+ GST + loading + transport extra) [V KUMAR call]
- ISMB 300×140 vs 300×150 option: **₹60 vs ₹63** (weight difference 42kg/m vs 46kg/m cited as the reason) [V R Earth Movers]
- Structural/plate rate escalation noted repeatedly: **"₹1500 increase ஆகும்"**, **"this month 1500 ரூபாய் increase"**
- TMT 20ton order: quoted **₹65,500**, earlier same customer recalled ₹58–59 "முன்னாடி" [V R Earth Movers 261010]
- MS/CR Plate market rate check-ins: **₹60–67/kg** band seen across multiple Vinayaga Steel Pradeep calls (e.g., "61 ₹ போயிட்டு இருக்கு sir, plate", "63.5 கொடுங்க ma'am")
- ISMB rate with grade premium: **E250 standard; E350 = +₹3,000** [V R Earth Movers 261010]
- 20mm Sale CRS: **₹69,000** quoted, loading free offered as a concession [Vanniar Narendrakumar]
- Saveetha Institute TMT bulk (40 tons): **12mm @ ₹69, 16mm @ ₹68.5** (+GST extra, not inclusive)
- TMT high-price period: customer quoted **₹65+**, commented "நம்ம budget-லாம் 50,52,54 அதெல்லாம் வருமான்னு தெரியல" showing budget vs market gap
- Zetwork/Harish calls: **₹62–63.5/kg** range with ₹500 step negotiations; 12mm carries **+₹500 coil-cut premium** over 8–10mm
- Transport/freight rates (separate from material): **₹1800** for 15–16 ton load (Trichy–Thuvakkudi), **₹18/ton-km** approx for Gudur/AP route, **₹2100+** for long-haul (Raichur/Hyderabad–Chennai)
- Standard commercial terms stated repeatedly: **"+ GST + loading + transport extra"** is the default quoting convention; basic/ex-work rate is quoted first, logistics added separately
- Payment/handling charge line item: **₹200 standard**, one dispute over **₹250** (vehicle-capacity-based, not fixed) — resolved via debit note
- Credit term observed: **1 month credit** causes price to differ from advance-payment rate (implicit informal credit vs cash-and-carry pricing)

## Objection Playbook

**"Rate ரொம்ப ஜாஸ்தி / reduce பண்ணுங்க" (price is too high / reduce it)**
- Rep response pattern: hold firm on quoted rate, cite market-wide increase as the reason ("rate எல்லாமே increase ஆயிடுச்சு"), avoid ad-hoc discounting on "final" rates. One rep explicitly refused to budge: *"கம்மி பண்ண முடியாது sir. கோச்சிக்காதீங்க. அந்த rate தான் final."*
- When discount IS given, it's framed as a loading/transport waiver, not a material price cut ("loading free பண்ணலாம்") — preserves headline rate integrity.

**"முந்தி rate கம்மியா கொடுத்தீங்க, இப்போ ஏன் கூட்டுறீங்க?" (you gave lower rate before)**
- Reps consistently blame upstream/mill pricing, not their own margin: *"ISMB cost இப்போ cost கூட இருக்கு இதுல"*, *"market அந்த மாதிரி இருக்கு sir"*.
